evidence.requirements: Most of the brief is met. The list shows name, family and L3, with Search and a Family select (index.html:14-28, format.js:88-103). Detail views use hash addresses (#/cartridge/<key>, app.js:3-11). The fact list includes the capacity link (app.js:65-85). Tables have Symbol/Value/Unit columns (app.js:87-105), tolerances sit next to their values (format.js:59-62) and angles are shown in DMS. The Print button and 'All cartridges' link exist, and the SVG has the accessible name '<name> drawing'. Partly met: (1) α has a leader arrow and label only (drawing.js:184-213), with no angular dimension line or extension lines; (2) the title block is an HTML div outside the drawing (app.js:120-126), and it says 'Scale 1:1, fitted to width' (drawing.js:408), which contradicts itself and is not a real scale; (3) the count says '1 cartridge' (format.js:101-103) where the brief asks for '<n> cartridges'; (4) in print the drawing is capped at max-height 134mm (styles.css:325-327), so it is not full width (print-308_win.jpg, about 80% width).
evidence.correctness: geometry.js follows the rules closely. Rim type uses the R1/P1 thresholds (19-26). The chamfer is (0, R1/2-min(f·tanβ,R1/4)) to (f, R1/2) (190-197). The rimfire half-round has radius min(R/2,(R1-P1)/2) (181-188). The groove and the belted ramp at δ run to R3/2, then to E (210-224). Body, shoulder and neck get r1 min and r2 fillets (227-240). Seating depth s and factor k follow the bullet shape, and m uses the brief's values (43-83). The tangent ogive ρ has its centre at G1/2-ρ (133-141). The heel uses H2-2tb (297-299). Walls are tn/tb with a linear blend across the shoulder (243-255). The head depth w and the primer pocket table are correct (266-271, 5-6). Missing r1Min/r2 is reported under the drawing (drawing.js:342-343). Screenshots match the outlines and proportions of reference/308_win, 300_win_mag, 9_mm_luger and 22_long_rifle (belt, groove, half-round rim, heeled bullet, SWC cone on 44 Rem. Mag.). Weak points: straight-case walls taper from tb to tn up to the bullet base (245-254), which the brief does not specify. Length dimensions are stacked longest-nearest (drawing.js:261), so the L1 and L2 extension lines cross the L3 and L6 dimension lines (detail-308_win.jpg); the reference puts the shortest nearest. Labels are fixed at 3.4 mm, so they look oversized next to short cases (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-9_mm_luger.jpg). The A4 print fits one page (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.security: No eval and no network calls. The SVG string goes in through innerHTML (app.js:119), but every text and the aria-label go through esc() (drawing.js:17-18, 372-385). The rest of the DOM is built with createElement/textNode (app.js:17-26). The only unescaped interpolation is rec.key in the pattern ids (drawing.js:387-392); it comes from the bundled data and is snake_case.
evidence.code_quality: Four focused modules: format, geometry, drawing, app (about 1,000 lines). Naming is clear and comments are short. Unknown bullet shapes throw (geometry.js:77). The label placer is a bounded backtracking search with a fallback (drawing.js:284-307): complex, but justified. Minor issues: layout() is recomputed on every innerRadius/headDepth call (geometry.js:337-343). Text widths are estimated with a fixed CHAR_W heuristic (drawing.js:72) rather than measured.
evidence.tests: There are 5 node:test files, run with `npm test`. They cover rim type, bullet s/k/m, walls, pockets, the belt ramp, the rimfire half-round, the heel, a cavity-vs-bullet check, non-self-intersecting sections, missing-value reporting, symbols/units/tolerance/DMS formatting, search incl. '7,62 x 51', and a label-overlap check over all 25 records (drawing.test.js:28-42). Missing: DOM/UI tests (rendering, the count, the filter UI, the detail facts, the print button, file:// loading), print/A4 checks and a11y checks. The overlap test reuses the same estimated text boxes as the placer, so it cannot catch real rendering overlaps.
evidence.ux_design: The list is dense and calm (list.jpg). The drawing is clean, with hatched sections and a dash-dot centre line. The print layout is good: two-column facts, five-column tables, source footer (print-308_win.jpg). On screen, though, every table heading sits in the left grid column with its table in the right (detail-*.jpg; caused by h3 and table as siblings in a 2-column grid, styles.css:223-227, 260-264). Half the page is wasted and headings are cut off from their tables. Labels on small cartridges are oversized (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg). No dark-mode or phone screenshot is provided; the CSS covers both (styles.css:16-25, 266-276).
evidence.accessibility: The SVG has role=img, aria-label and <title> (drawing.js:384-385). Inputs have <label for> (index.html:15-18). The count is aria-live (index.html:27). Tables use th scope=col/row (app.js:93-98). The facts use a dl. Controls are native links and buttons with default focus rings, and lang=en is set. Muted text #5b626b on #fafaf7 has adequate contrast. The detail h1 comes after the nav. The drawing has no long description, though the tables carry the same data.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime or dev dependencies (package.json), plain scripts loaded in order, so it works from file://. The code size fits the task. The label-placement search is the one heavyweight part, and it is warranted by the no-overlap rule.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, docs, ADRs, spec, CI configuration or changelog in app/. package.json has a test script but no engines field or Node version pin, and the version is 0.1.0. There are no run or file:// instructions and no notes on design decisions (e.g. the straight-case wall taper or the w interpretation for belted cases). Unit tests give some regression safety.
evidence.visual_design: Neutral palette, system font, tabular numbers and thin rules give a technical feel (list.jpg). The print output looks finished. On screen, the split heading/table grid looks broken, and the label size jumps between cartridges (huge on 22 LR and 9 mm, moderate on 300 Win. Mag.). The HTML title block sits detached under the drawing.
evidence.layout: The list page is well structured. On detail pages, facts come first, then the drawing and title block, then the tables. The table section is misaligned on every detail screenshot: headings fill a wide empty left column and tables sit on the right, which doubles the page length. Long vertical leader lines push the diameter labels far below the drawing (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, H2 label). No clipping or overlaps are visible. Print fits A4 (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.usability: Getting from the list to a detail view and back takes one click. Search filters on every keystroke, and the family select and count update together. Addresses can be bookmarked. There is a not-found message with a way back (index.html:31). Print uses window.print. Small issue: the facts show raw codes such as 'lr' and 'sp' with no explanation.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would trust the data and the drawings: values match the records, and the proportions match the OpenBallistics references. The print sheet is useful. The broken table layout on screen and the uneven label scale look unfinished, and the inaccurate 'Scale 1:1, fitted to width' line undermines trust with a drafting-literate audience.

unmet_requirements: Shoulder angle α has a leader and label but no angular dimension line with arrowheads and extension lines (drawing.js:184-213)
Title block is an HTML box outside the drawing, and its scale line 'Scale 1:1, fitted to width' gives no real scale (app.js:120-126, drawing.js:408)
Count reads '1 cartridge' instead of '<n> cartridges' for one result (format.js:101-103)
Printed drawing is capped at 134mm height, so it is not full width (styles.css:325-327, print-308_win.jpg)
No README or run instructions, no CI, no pinned Node version (maintainability; brief asks for a process covering specs and verification)
strengths: The geometry engine follows nearly every drawing rule exactly: chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt ramp at δ, filleted shoulder, tangent ogive, heeled bullet, walls, head depth and primer pocket. Outlines match the reference proportions.
Label placement uses a backtracking search with a test over all 25 records, so labels do not overlap each other or the outline in any screenshot.
No dependencies; works from file://. Data formatting is right (tolerances inline, DMS angles, units, symbols). The printed A4 sheet is compact and complete.
issues: On screen, the detail tables are laid out wrongly: each h3 heading lands in the left grid column and its table in the right (styles.css:223-227, 260-264). This wastes half the page and separates headings from their tables in every detail screenshot.

Drafting conventions are weak: α is shown with a leader, not an angular dimension; length dimensions are stacked longest-nearest, so extension lines cross dimension lines; the fixed 3.4 mm label size looks oversized on short cases; the title block sits outside the drawing and its 'Scale 1:1, fitted to width' line is misleading.
The repository has no README, docs, CI or pinned Node version, and the tests stop at units: no UI, print or accessibility tests.
review.verdict: The drawing geometry is faithful to the brief's rules and the data, and the print sheet is good. The screen detail layout is broken, the angle and title-block details fall short, and there is no documentation or CI, so it needs another pass before publishing to a technical audience.
